CREATE TABLE "public"."storeSettings" (
  "address" text,
  "city" text,
  "country" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'TND' NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "id" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "reportFooter" text,
  "secondaryPhone" text,
  "storeName" text DEFAULT 'Herb Store' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "website" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "store_settings_currency_ea996e0a" CHECK (currency = 'TND'),
  CONSTRAINT "store_settings_name_93a0ca73" CHECK (length(btrim("storeName")) BETWEEN 1 AND 160),
  CONSTRAINT "store_settings_singleton_7faf435e" CHECK (id = 1)
)
